latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of TikTok Ads Strategy skill, focusing on creative-first campaigns and optimization.

- Covers TikTok ad types: In-Feed Ads, Spark Ads, TopView, Branded Hashtag Challenge, and Collection Ads
- Provides targeting, bidding, creative framework, and campaign structure guidance for B2B SaaS, apps, and consumer brands
- Emphasizes the pivotal role of creative quality and UGC/creator content
- Includes step-by-step execution advice, with paths for both manual setup or AdKit CLI users
- Lists relevant triggers for easy invocation
